description: Settings window: reads and saves the provider, model and Custom base URL, saves or clears keys, lists the built-in model names, tests a key and model against its provider, changes the shortcut and start-with-Windows, shows the app version and the updates state, checks for updates, installs an offered update, turns automatic update checks on or off, manages instruction sets, and closes itself (Esc, Ctrl+W). It can ask whether a key is saved but can never read one.
